import csv
import re
import sys
from collections import Counter, defaultdict

# Read the CSV
rows = []
with open\(r'C:\\Users\\Lenie\\Downloads\\export \(2\).csv', 'r', encoding='utf-8-sig'\) as f:
    reader = csv.DictReader\(f\)
    for r in reader:
        rows.append\(r\)

print\(f"=== CSV AUDIT ==="\)
print\(f"Total rows: {len\(rows\)}"\)

# 1. Check for Total Errors > 1
total_errors_counts = Counter\(\)
for r in rows:
    te = r.get\('Total Errors', '1'\).strip\(\)
    total_errors_counts[te] += 1
print\(f"\\n--- Total Errors column values ---"\)
for val, cnt in total_errors_counts.most_common\(\):
    print\(f"  '{val}': {cnt} rows"\)

implied_total = sum\(int\(r.get\('Total Errors', '1'\).strip\(\) or '1'\) for r in rows\)
print\(f"  Sum of Total Errors: {implied_total}"\)
if implied_total != len\(rows\):
    print\(f"  *** WARNING: Total Errors sum \({implied_total}\) != row count \({len\(rows\)}\). Some rows represent multiple errors! ***"\)

# 2. Check for missing fields \(would cause import to skip\)
missing = []
for i, r in enumerate\(rows\):
    ident = r.get\('Identifier', ''\).strip\(\)
    date = r.get\('Message Date', ''\).strip\(\)
    error = r.get\('Error Text', ''\).strip\(\)
    ep = r.get\('Endpoint Name', ''\).strip\(\)
    if not ident or not date or not error:
        missing.append\({
            'row': i+2,
            'endpoint': ep,
            'identifier': ident[:30] if ident else '\(empty\)',
            'has_date': bool\(date\),
            'has_error': bool\(error\),
            'error_preview': error[:80] if error else '\(empty\)'
        }\)

print\(f"\\n--- Rows that would be SKIPPED \(missing identifier/date/error\) ---"\)
print\(f"  Count: {len\(missing\)}"\)
for m in missing:
    print\(f"  Row {m['row']}: endpoint='{m['endpoint']}', id='{m['identifier']}', date={m['has_date']}, error={m['has_error']}"\)
    if m['error_preview'] != '\(empty\)':
        print\(f"    error: {m['error_preview']}"\)

# 3. Error classification rules \(matching the import-csv.ts\)
RULES = [
    \('MAP-CUST', 'MAPPING', re.compile\(r'customer.*\(not \(found|mapped\)|missing\)|enter a value for.*entity|Entity Id.*invalid', re.I\)\),
    \('MAP-ITEM', 'MAPPING', re.compile\(r'\(item|sku\).*\(not \(found|mapped\)|invalid\)|choose an item|at least one line item|Invalid Field Value.*item|sub-resource field \\'item\\'', re.I\)\),
    \('MAP-SHIP', 'MAPPING', re.compile\(r'\(ship.?to|address\).*\(not \(found|mapped\)|invalid\)|Ship To Select', re.I\)\),
    \('MAP-LOC', 'MAPPING', re.compile\(r'\(location|store|shop\).*\(not \(found|mapped\)\)', re.I\)\),
    \('IDX-SKIP', 'INDEXING', re.compile\(r'skipped|no index|not indexed', re.I\)\),
    \('TAX-VERTEX', 'NETSUITE', re.compile\(r'vertex|tax \(calc|service\)', re.I\)\),
    \('INV-ITEM', 'NETSUITE', re.compile\(r'inventory|insufficient|not recognized', re.I\)\),
    \('NS-PERM', 'NETSUITE', re.compile\(r'permission|role|insufficient privilege', re.I\)\),
    \('VAL-DATA', 'NETSUITE', re.compile\(r'INVALID_VALUE|FIELD_PARAM_REQD|unable to parse|Integer field|fulfilled.*delete|otherrefnum|maximum number|required|validation', re.I\)\),
    \('API-RATE', 'TRANSIENT', re.compile\(r'rate limit|429|timeout|timed out|Request Failed|UNEXPECTED_ERROR|Record has been changed|someone.*saving|Primary.?Key|NONEXISTENT_ID', re.I\)\),
    \('DUP', 'TRANSIENT', re.compile\(r'duplicate|already exists', re.I\)\),
    \('CONN-DOWN', 'OUTAGE', re.compile\(r'heartbeat|connector offline', re.I\)\),
]

def classify\(text\):
    for code, group, pattern in RULES:
        if pattern.search\(text\):
            return code, group
    return 'VAL-DATA', 'NETSUITE'  # fallback

# 4. Flow assignment rules \(matching import-csv.ts AFTER our fix\)
def endpoint_to_flow\(ep_name\):
    ep = ep_name.lower\(\)
    if 'save ecomm order' in ep or 'update work order' in ep: return 'S2N'
    if 'shopify - read' in ep or 'sh - update draft' in ep or 'ns - update draft' in ep: return 'N2S'
    if 'netsuite - sales order' in ep: return 'S2N'  # FIXED
    if 'save order fulfillment' in ep: return 'N2S'
    if any\(x in ep for x in ['save items', 'index', 'save customer', 'contact save', 'company']\): return 'IDX'
    if any\(x in ep for x in ['shopify - company', 'shopify - contact', 'shopify - price']\): return 'IDX'
    if any\(x in ep for x in ['customer save', 'company save', 'contact save']\): return 'IDX'
    if 'shopify' in ep: return 'S2N'
    return 'NS'

# 5. Transaction type rules
def endpoint_to_txn_type\(ep_name\):
    ep = ep_name.lower\(\)
    if 'draft order' in ep or 'draft' in ep: return 'Draft Order'
    if 'fulfillment' in ep: return 'Fulfillment'
    if 'save items' in ep: return 'Item'
    if 'save ecomm order' in ep or 'update work order' in ep or 'sales order' in ep: return 'Sales Order'
    if 'shopify - read' in ep: return 'Order'
    if any\(x in ep for x in ['company', 'contact', 'customer']\): return 'Customer'
    return 'Order'

# Run classification on all valid rows
flow_cat = defaultdict\(lambda: defaultdict\(int\)\)
flow_group = defaultdict\(lambda: defaultdict\(int\)\)
flow_totals = Counter\(\)
unique_errors = defaultdict\(set\)
txn_types = defaultdict\(lambda: defaultdict\(int\)\)
fallback_count = 0

for r in rows:
    ident = r.get\('Identifier', ''\).strip\(\)
    date = r.get\('Message Date', ''\).strip\(\)
    error = r.get\('Error Text', ''\).strip\(\)
    ep = r.get\('Endpoint Name', ''\).strip\(\)
    
    if not ident or not date or not error:
        continue
    
    flow = endpoint_to_flow\(ep\)
    code, group = classify\(error\)
    flow_cat[flow][code] += 1
    flow_group[flow][group] += 1
    flow_totals[flow] += 1
    unique_errors[\(flow, code\)].add\(error[:100]\)
    
    txn_type = endpoint_to_txn_type\(ep\)
    txn_types[flow][txn_type] += 1
    
    # Check for fallback classification
    matched = False
    for c, g, p in RULES:
        if p.search\(error\):
            matched = True
            break
    if not matched:
        fallback_count += 1
        print\(f"  FALLBACK \(no pattern match\): flow={flow}, ep='{ep}', error='{error[:80]}'"\)

print\(f"\\n--- Expected Flow Distribution \(after fix\) ---"\)
for flow in ['S2N', 'N2S', 'IDX', 'NS']:
    print\(f"  {flow}: {flow_totals[flow]} errors"\)
print\(f"  Total: {sum\(flow_totals.values\(\)\)}"\)

print\(f"\\n--- Expected Error Categories by Flow ---"\)
for flow in ['S2N', 'N2S', 'IDX', 'NS']:
    if flow_cat[flow]:
        print\(f"  {flow}:"\)
        for code, cnt in sorted\(flow_cat[flow].items\(\), key=lambda x: -x[1]\):
            group = [g for c, g, p in RULES if c == code]
            group = group[0] if group else '?'
            print\(f"    {code} \({group}\): {cnt}"\)

print\(f"\\n--- Fallback classifications \(no explicit pattern match\) ---"\)
print\(f"  Count: {fallback_count}"\)

print\(f"\\n--- Transaction Types by Flow ---"\)
for flow in ['S2N', 'N2S', 'IDX', 'NS']:
    if txn_types[flow]:
        print\(f"  {flow}:"\)
        for tt, cnt in sorted\(txn_types[flow].items\(\), key=lambda x: -x[1]\):
            print\(f"    {tt}: {cnt}"\)

print\(f"\\n--- Unique Error Texts per Flow/Category ---"\)
for \(flow, code\), errors in sorted\(unique_errors.items\(\)\):
    print\(f"  {flow}/{code} \({len\(errors\)} unique texts\):"\)
    for e in sorted\(errors\)[:3]:
        print\(f"    - {e}"\)
    if len\(errors\) > 3:
        print\(f"    ... and {len\(errors\)-3} more"\)

# 6. Check endpoints that fall to default flow \(NS\)
print\(f"\\n--- Endpoints falling to default NS flow ---"\)
ns_endpoints = set\(\)
for r in rows:
    ep = r.get\('Endpoint Name', ''\).strip\(\)
    if ep and endpoint_to_flow\(ep\) == 'NS':
        ns_endpoints.add\(ep\)
if ns_endpoints:
    for ep in sorted\(ns_endpoints\):
        print\(f"  '{ep}' -> NS \(default\)"\)
else:
    print\("  None - all endpoints map to specific flows"\)
PYEOF)
